answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. What survives to the atlas is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A kernel of per-task receipts records who did what, and the oasis of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
